sources.entry: KubeSwitch - KubeSwitch lists the available kubernetes cluster contexts on the mac, in Mac's Menu bar.

summary.one_liner: KubeSwitch is a macOS menu bar app that lists the Kubernetes cluster contexts available on a Mac and lets the user view and switch the current one.
summary.what_it_does: KubeSwitch shows the Kubernetes cluster contexts available on a Mac as a menu bar item. It displays which context is currently selected and lets the user change that selection from the menu bar. The README lists three capabilities: viewing available contexts, viewing the current context, and changing the current context. A download link for v1.0.1 is provided, and the app can be opened from Terminal with `open -a KubeSwitch`. The README includes no details on how contexts are read or how the selection is applied to kubeconfig.
use_cases: switch kubernetes context from the mac menu bar
see which kubernetes cluster is currently active
list available kubectl contexts on macos
how_to_run: Download v1.0.1 from the project's Download link
Open the app, or run `open -a KubeSwitch` from Terminal
notable: Lives in the Mac menu bar as a single status item
Shows the current Kubernetes context and lets you change it
Launchable from Terminal with open -a KubeSwitch
caveats: README is minimal: no screenshot shown, no build or install steps beyond the download link
Latest version listed in the README is v1.0.1 (2019 copyright), so maintenance status is unclear
